total_model.summary: Model projects 49.2 total points (CIN 30, NO 19). Biggest factors: Combined offense EPA/play (last 8 games) (raises total 1.6), Wind x pass rate (lowers total 1.0), Combined rush defense EPA allowed/play (raises total 0.8). The baseline of 45.7 is the typical NFL total in the training data.
